meaningEn: Expressing passive action ('is done / is being made / becomes').

notesEn.formation: Base Verbs add ~이/히/리/기 or 하다 becomes 되다.
notesEn.usage: Used when the subject experiences or receives an action rather than performing it.
notesEn.nuance: Different stems take specific passive suffixes (e.g., 보다 -> 보이다, 먹다 -> 먹히다, 열다 -> 열리다, 닫다 -> 닫히다).

notesId.formation: Kata Kerja Dasar ditambah ~이/히/리/기 atau 하다 menjadi 되다.
notesId.usage: Digunakan ketika subjek mengalami atau menerima tindakan, bukan melakukannya.
notesId.nuance: Kata dasar yang berbeda menggunakan akhiran pasif tertentu (contoh: 보다 -> 보이다, 먹다 -> 먹히다, 열다 -> 열리다, 닫다 -> 닫히다).

examples.meaningEn: The mountain can be seen far away.

quiz.question: What is the passive form of '열다' (to open)?
quiz.explanationEn: 열다 takes the passive suffix ~리~ to become 열리다 (to be opened).
quiz.explanationId: 열다 menggunakan akhiran pasif ~리~ untuk menjadi 열리다 (terbuka/dibuka).

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: The door was opened. -> 문이 열___어요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Combine passive suffix ~리~ with past tense ~었~.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Gabungkan akhiran pasif ~리~ dengan bentuk lampau ~었~.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'The door was opened.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use door subject (문이) + open passive past (열렸어요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan subjek pintu (문이) + pasif buka lampau (열렸어요).

meaningEn: Causative expression ('make / cause / let someone do something').
meaningId: Ekspresi kausatif ('membuat / menyuruh / membiarkan seseorang melakukan sesuatu').

notesEn.formation: Base verbs take ~이/히/리/기/우/추 or Verb Stem + ~게 하다.
notesEn.usage: Used when the subject makes or enables another person/object to perform an action.
notesEn.nuance: Common verbs: 먹다 -> 먹이다 (feed), 자다 -> 재우다 (put to sleep), 입다 -> 입히다 (dress someone).

notesId.formation: Kata kerja dasar ditambah ~이/히/리/기/우/추 atau Kata Dasar + ~게 하다.
notesId.usage: Digunakan ketika subjek membuat atau menyebabkan orang/benda lain melakukan suatu tindakan.
notesId.nuance: Kata kerja umum: 먹다 -> 먹이다 (menyuapi/gabung makan), 자다 -> 재우다 (menidurkan), 입다 -> 입히다 (mengenakan pakaian ke orang lain).

examples.meaningEn: I dress the child (make the child wear clothes).
I put the baby to sleep.
I fed my younger sibling bread.

quiz.question: What is the causative form of '입다' (to wear) meaning 'to dress someone'?
quiz.explanationEn: 입다 takes ~히~ to become 입히다 (to dress someone).
quiz.explanationId: 입다 menggunakan ~히~ untuk menjadi 입히다 (mengenakan pakaian ke orang lain).

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I dress the child. -> 아이에게 옷을 입___요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Conjugate causative stem 입히~ into standard polite present style (~혀요).
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Konjugasikan kata dasar kausatif 입히~ ke bentuk sopan standar (~혀요).

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'I dress the child.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Saya mengenakan pakaian pada anak.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use child to (아이에게) + clothes (옷을) + dress causative (입혀요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan kepada anak (아이에게) + pakaian (옷을) + kausatif pakai (입혀요).

meaningEn: Immediate sequential action ('as soon as / right after').
meaningId: Tindakan berurutan secara langsung ('segera setelah / begitu...').

notesEn.usage: Indicates that the action in the second clause happens immediately after the action in the first clause.
notesEn.nuance: Do not attach tense markers (~았/었~) to ~자마자; tense is expressed in the final verb.

notesId.usage: Menunjukkan bahwa tindakan pada klausa kedua terjadi segera setelah tindakan pada klausa pertama selesai.
notesId.nuance: Jangan menempelkan penanda waktu (~았/었~) pada ~자마자; bentuk waktu dinyatakan pada kata kerja akhir.

examples.meaningEn: As soon as I came home, I washed my hands.
examples.meaningId: Segera setelah sampai di rumah, saya mencuci tangan.

examples.meaningEn: Right after class finished, I met my friend.
examples.meaningId: Begitu kelas selesai, saya bertemu teman.

examples.meaningEn: As soon as the alarm rang, I woke up.
examples.meaningId: Begitu alarm berbunyi, saya langsung bangun.

quiz.question: Which connector means 'as soon as' attached to verb stems?
quiz.explanationEn: ~자마자 indicates an immediate sequence of two actions.
quiz.explanationId: ~자마자 menunjukkan urutan langsung dari dua tindakan.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: As soon as I came home, I washed my hands. -> 집에 오___ 손을 씻었어요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Attach 'as soon as' connector to verb stem 오.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Tempelkan penghubung 'segera setelah' pada kata dasar 오.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'As soon as I came home, I washed my hands.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Segera setelah sampai di rumah, saya mencuci tangan.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use home to (집에) + come as soon as (오자마자) + hands (손을) + washed (씻었어요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan ke rumah (집에) + begitu datang (오자마자) + tangan (손을) + mencuci lampau (씻었어요).

meaningEn: Simultaneous actions performed by the same subject ('while doing').
meaningId: Tindakan bersamaan yang dilakukan oleh subjek yang sama ('sambil / seraya').

notesEn.usage: Connects two actions happening at the exact same time by one person.
notesEn.nuance: The subjects of both clauses must be identical.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar berakhiran Vokal -> ~면서 / Kata Dasar berakhiran Konsonan -> ~으면서.
notesId.usage: Menghubungkan dua tindakan yang terjadi pada waktu yang bersamaan oleh satu orang.
notesId.nuance: Subjek dari kedua klausa harus sama.

examples.meaningEn: I study while listening to music.
I watch TV while eating a meal.
You must not talk on the phone while driving.

quiz.question: How do you combine '듣다' (to listen) with 'while'?
quiz.explanationEn: 듣다 is a ㄷ-irregular verb; ㄷ changes to ㄹ before a vowel, becoming 들으면서.
quiz.explanationId: 듣다 adalah kata kerja tidak beraturan ㄷ; ㄷ berubah menjadi ㄹ di depan vokal, menjadi 들으면서.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I study while listening to music. -> 음악을 들___ 공부해요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Attach 'while' suffix to irregular stem 들.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Tempelkan akhiran 'sambil' pada kata dasar tidak beraturan 들.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'I study while listening to music.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Saya belajar sambil mendengarkan musik.'

pattern: Verb/Adj Stem + ~(으)ㄴ/는 대신에 (In exchange for / Instead of)
meaningEn: Substitution or compensation ('instead of / in exchange for').

notesEn.formation: Present Verb: ~는 대신에 / Past Verb & Adj: ~(으)ㄴ 대신에 / Noun: Noun + 대신에.
notesEn.usage: Indicates substituting one action/thing for another, or providing a compensation.
notesEn.nuance: Can also contrast two opposing characteristics of something.

notesId.formation: Kata Kerja Present: ~는 대신에 / Kata Kerja Lampau & Kata Sifat: ~(으)ㄴ 대신에 / Kata Benda: Kata Benda + 대신에.
notesId.usage: Menunjukkan penggantian suatu tindakan/benda dengan yang lain, atau memberikan kompensasi.
notesId.nuance: Juga dapat membandingkan dua sifat yang berlawanan dari sesuatu.

examples.meaningEn: I drink water instead of coffee.
examples.meaningId: Saya minum air putih sebagai ganti kopi.

examples.hangul: 제가 밥을 사는 대신에 커피를 사 주세요.
examples.romaja: je-ga bab-eul sa-neun dae-sin-e keo-pi-reul sa ju-se-yo.
examples.meaningEn: In exchange for me buying lunch, please buy me coffee.
examples.meaningId: Sebagai ganti saya traktir makan, tolong belikan saya kopi.

examples.hangul: 이 방은 작은 대신에 값이 싸요.
examples.romaja: i bang-eun ja-geun dae-sin-e gap-si ssa-yo.
examples.meaningEn: This room is cheap, in exchange for being small.
examples.meaningId: Kamar ini harganya murah, tetapi ukurannya kecil.

quiz.question: Which phrase correctly means 'instead of coffee' using a noun?
quiz.explanationId: Kata benda menggunakan 대신에 secara langsung (커피 대신에).

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I drink water instead of coffee. -> 커피 ___ 물을 마셔요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Attach 'instead of' directly to noun 커피.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Tempelkan 'sebagai ganti' secara langsung pada kata benda 커피.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'I drink water instead of coffee.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Saya minum air putih sebagai ganti kopi.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use coffee instead (커피 대신에) + water (물을) + drink (마셔요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan alih-alih kopi (커피 대신에) + air (물을) + minum (마셔요).
